about: Spec-sync rules for tools/process/check_process.py (sync). A rule fires when one of its triggers changed in the range; it is satisfied when every path in require_all changed in the same range, or when a commit in the range carries 'Spec-Sync-Waiver: <id>: <reason>'. docs/process/DEVELOPMENT-PROCESS.md lists every rule id as `sync:<id>`; the docs check fails if the two disagree. RFC-W001 records why each rule exists and what it measured on history.

rules.description: A params_delta field was added, removed or redefined (name, path, type, layer, live flag, range) in the engine's kFields table, so its API-SPEC section changes in the same range.
A params_delta field name was added or removed, so parity_schema.py learns it (its NATIVE_ONLY list and the order check) in the same range.
The host's method set changed, or the TypeScript protocol types changed, so desktop/HOST-PROTOCOL.md changes in the same range.
rules.source: desktop/HOST-PROTOCOL.md:15-17 (upstream requires a same-commit edit for breaking changes; this project extends it to additive ones, RFC-W001 §3.3)

rules.description: A workflow changed, so the gate table in the development process document (the current fact of what CI runs) changes in the same range.
rules.source: AGENTS.md:33-43 (a document that describes a deleted thing is a defect); .github/workflows/desktop.yml:1-21

rules.description: The checker's rules or behaviour changed, so RFC-W001 (the module's design record) changes in the same range.
